comment: Zul'Gurub and Ahn'Qiraj (issue #23): the quests of both raids, the Zandalar Tribe reputation and the quests that open the Ahn'Qiraj gates. Chains only: no saga route holds them. Selection rules: tools/select_zg_aq.py.

chains.name: Zul'Gurub
chains.summary: 2 quests for Zul'Gurub at required level 40. The quests start with Prospector Ironboot.

chains.name: Zandalar Tribe
chains.summary: 2 quests for Zandalar Tribe at required level 58. The quests start with Exzhal, Vinchaxa.

chains.name: Ahn'Qiraj
chains.summary: 27 quests for Ahn'Qiraj at required level 60. The quests start with Kandrostrasz, Narain Soothfancy, Dirge Quikcleave and 6 more.
